title: Best Reminder App, Period!
body:
Ever since adding support for critical alerts, this app has been perfect.

I use it for all the things I really need to do at a certain time. One example is canceling subscriptions. You set the date and time you want to cancel. If you allow Due, it will keep nagging you until you've done it. I guess this saved me a lot of money.

It also just works and it does one thing and it does it well! Kudos to the developer!

title: Good app gone bad
body:
Due was a very good app. Now, an update has come.

What a let-down!

I have NEVER before experienced that an update removes features from an app that you have to buy back if you want to keep using them.
Yet the developer is doing exactly that. Useful features such as pausing timers have disappeared and now you have to buy them back via an in-app update!
To me that looks like ripping off your loyal customers.

Apart from that, while it looks more polished, navigation is actually more complicated, defeating another great feature of the app as it was.

Due will be removed from my devices, and I will go looking for an alternative.
